app_store.name: Atelier: AI Artifact Studio
app_store.subtitle: Interactive Code & Prototyping
app_store.promotional_text: Run interactive code artifacts live. Bring your own model keys with local privacy and multi-provider flexibility.
app_store.description:
Atelier is a local-first workbench for developers and creators who build with AI.

Turn prompts into working interactive prototypes. Inspect code side-by-side with a live React and HTML preview sandbox.

Key Capabilities:
- Interactive Artifacts: Live execution for React, Tailwind, and SVG components
- Bring Your Own Key: Connect your preferred model providers with zero artificial rate limits
- Multi-Model Freedom: Choose between high-intelligence reasoning and high-speed execution
- Local-First Privacy: Keep your sessions and data stored securely on your device
- One-Click Export: Download clean source code or full file bundles instantly

Free for local development. Pro sync is $9 a month.
app_store.whats_new: Initial release with live sandboxed React previews and multi-model support.
